recipe.loss: Unchanged TRAIN-only signed4 encoding, all original nodes MSE/4. Each chunk weighted by its node count over N; one optimizer update per whole case.
recipe.case_order: Existing PythonRandom2026 shuffled120 case keys for four passes;480 stored updates; each known3 case exposed four times, independent of model RNG.
recipe.geometry_input: One shared1024 original cloud-index replay per canonical CAD: xyz3+nonforce19 features=22; current force/moment slots7:13 excluded; same BC22 encoder64/global32 for both arms.
recipe.query_input: Original xyz plus nonforce19 local features and explicit global32; u basis independent of actual force6. Stress branch sees actual normalized load6 separately.
recipe.u_units: Zero-centered V[k,j]=B[k,j]/existing std_j; alpha from normalized load6 verified basis; encoded_u=sum(alpha*V)-mean/std once; physical_u=std*sum(alpha*V).
recipe.stress: Independent head with actual normalized force/moment6; unchanged signed scalar asinh encoding, no stress superposition claim.
recipe.architecture_comparison: DeepONet branch/trunk contraction vs local concatMLP with common BC22/cloud/scaler/factorization/protocol; heads/counts differ and are disclosed. Common encoder constructor/seed only; no whole-model equal-init/equal-capacity claim.
recipe.gradient: BC cloud encoded once per case. Detach global32 to a leaf, accumulate exact node-weighted head/query gradients for all chunks, then context.backward(leaf.grad) once through original encoder graph. No cloud recoding per chunk or cross-step context reuse.
recipe.selection: Fixed480 primary; common knownVAL15 score0.5*(case-mean U relativeL2+signedstress relativeL2), validation-best secondary; no training-best or dia-based selection.
recipe.timing: Primary train_seconds begins before ordinary selection load_case+BCcloud read/H2D and ends after complete allnode update/Adam/sync. New45CAD BCcloud preparation cost/coverage retained separately and is not hidden in model train cost. Inference timed after normal input/H2D; evaluationwall includes input loads. Overlapping cost fields are not summed. Raw runwall includes model startup/evaluation/checkpoint IO.
recipe.precision: Same float32/TF32/high/noautocast as existing screen; physical scalerdecode/metrics float64.

access.author: Source plus one AST/metadata check; no scientific arrays/models/weights/GPU

checkpoint: Atomic last/best/step0,120,240,480; last first update/every30. Full model/Adam/Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG/order/nextposition/case-node exposure/passcost/history restore; no oldsolver warm start.
first_actual_check: Only first complete realcase training update: BC22/global/output shape, alpha and forceN/momentNmm units, reused first8node basis affine offset once, finite positive active encoder/querytrunk/basis/stress gradients. Onehot inactive basis rows may have zero gradient; no toy, pre-scan or extra forward.

development_dia.checkpoint_selection: Both completed fresh endpoint480 last.pt only, strict same config/order/exposures; no dia choice of checkpoint/seed/budget
development_dia.known3: Reuse completed endpoint summaries; no repeated known3 prediction
development_dia.input_check: Original node order/xyz and nonforce19 exact to canonical ver input; same BC22 cloud/mask for both routes; finite constant normalized load6 in existing rank3 span
development_dia.label_access: For each DEVdia case, both full-node predictions and physical decode finish before opening displacement/stress members; input loads access only xyz/features first
development_dia.scope: Previously explored DEV5/dia structural diagnostic, not unseen final generalization; oldfinal/newsealedtest untouched

limitations: BCcloud uses exact original random1024 indices and may miss rare boundary roles; perCAD coverage disclosed, no oversampling/repair
